content_sections.heading: About NIEPMD Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The National Institute for Empowerment of Persons with Multiple Disabilities (Divyangjan) functions under the Dept. of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan), Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India. Located at Muttukadu, East Coast Road, Kovalam (P.O), Chennai - 603 112, Tamil Nadu - India, the institute is accredited by NAAC and holds ISO 9001:2015 certification. This recruitment drive is conducted under Expression of Interest notice EOI-01/2026 to empanel Allied Faculty for the B.ASLP Programme.

rows.post: Assistant Professor (Electronics, Otolaryngology, Linguistics, Statistics, Neurology)
rows.qualification_required: A Post Graduate Degree or equivalent professional qualification in the relevant discipline from a recognized university/Institution. Registration with the respective statutory professional council wherever applicable.
rows.experience: Not specified in the notification. Desirable: Familiarity with interdisciplinary teaching in rehabilitation sciences and allied health sciences.

rows.qualification_required: Diploma in Hearing Aid and Ear Mould Technology (DHA & ET) or equivalent certification. Valid Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) registration.

Diploma/ Bachelor’s Degree in Biomedical engineering, Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering, electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a relevant technical discipline from a recognized Institution.
rows.experience: Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in Maintenance, troubleshooting and servicing of medical/clinical equipment. Desirable: Experience in maintenance and calibration of aetiological, speech language and rehabilitation equipment.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Engagement of Allied Faculty will be strictly on a part-time/consultancy basis for teaching various subjects in the Bachelor of Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology (B.ASLP) Programme. Remuneration will be paid on per hour basis and commensurate with qualification & experience, as per prevailing norms in the Institute.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are released under NIEPMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies across Assistant Professor and Technician posts in the Department of Speech, Hearing & Communication.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NIEPMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted within 10 –days from the date of this advertisement published in Newspaper.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold A Post Graduate Degree or equivalent professional qualification in the relevant discipline from a recognized university/Institution, along with Registration with the respective statutory professional council wherever applicable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary or remuneration for Allied Faculty at NIEPMD?
faq.answer: Remuneration will be paid on per hour basis and commensurate with qualification & experience, as per prevailing norms in the Institute.

faq.question: Q5. Is the NIEPMD Allied Faculty engagement permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The engagement is strictly on a part-time/consultancy basis for teaching various subjects in the Bachelor of Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology (B.ASLP) Programme.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for the Ear Mould Technician post?
faq.answer: Candidates require a Diploma in Hearing Aid and Ear Mould Technology (DHA & ET) or equivalent certification, valid Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) registration, and 2 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for NIEPMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates may submit their complete Biodata & copies of relevant documents at the following address by post/email for empanelment within 10 –days from the date of this advertisement published in Newspaper.

faq.question: Q8. What are the requirements for the Bio-Medical Technician post?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Diploma/ Bachelor’s Degree in Biomedical engineering, Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering, electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a relevant technical discipline from a recognized Institution with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in Maintenance, troubleshooting and servicing of medical/clinical equipment.
